# The Pragmatic Method Is an Attitude of Orientation

No particular results then, so far, but only an attitude of orientation, is what the pragmatic method means.[^1] THE ATTITUDE OF LOOKING AWAY FROM FIRST THINGS, PRINCIPLES, 'CATEGORIES,' SUPPOSED NECESSITIES; AND OF LOOKING TOWARDS LAST THINGS, FRUITS, CONSEQUENCES, FACTS.[^2]

[^1]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The Method's Character and Affinities]] "No particular results then, so far, but only an attitude of orientation, is what the pragmatic method means."
[^2]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#The Method's Character and Affinities]] "THE ATTITUDE OF LOOKING AWAY FROM FIRST THINGS, PRINCIPLES, 'CATEGORIES,' SUPPOSED NECESSITIES; AND OF LOOKING TOWARDS LAST THINGS, FRUITS, CONSEQUENCES, FACTS."
